data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 308 recorded an opening gross claims outstanding of GBP 10.154m. During 2016 the syndicate reported a small prior-year release (net) of GBP 0.8m arising from reassessment of claims for previous accident years (favourable run-off / IBNR recalibration). The movement is reported net of reinsurance; no explicit gross prior-year movement was disclosed. The syndicate's calendar-year result was otherwise impacted by a higher-than-normal loss frequency on the underlying book, but overall the prior-year reassessment produced a modest improvement.
raw_causal_phrases: Within the calendar year technical result, a surplus of GBP 0.8m (2015: surplus of GBP 1.0m) relates to the reassessment of net claims incurred for previous accident years.
Whilst the underlying book continues to produce profitable results, the account was negatively affected by a higher than normal loss frequency.
The 2014 underwriting year result improved by GBP 0.3m as a result of a small release from the prior years due to the positive run-off of some legacy accounts.
data.data_quality_notes: No explicit GROSS prior-year movement figure was disclosed for Syndicate 308. The report explicitly states a NET surplus of GBP 0.8m relating to reassessment of prior accident years; per extraction rules this NET figure has been used as a fallback. A gross claims development triangle exists and, if used, suggests a small gross strengthening (~+0.2m) for older years; this conflicts with the stated NET release. Therefore the prior_year_development_gbp_m is the NET figure (-0.8m) and should be interpreted with caution. LOB mapping for Syndicate 308 (life/term life) is imperfect against the provided standard LOB list; 'Accident & Health' was used as the closest standard category for LOB movement reporting.
